title: Kubernetes resource name
summary: A Kubernetes resource name is a DNS subdomain name (RFC 1123): lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, max 253 characters, must start and end with alphanumeric. Resource names are unique within a namespace.

notes: DNS subdomain name: lowercase, alphanumeric, hyphens.
Must start and end with alphanumeric.
Unique within a namespace (for namespaced resources).
Some resources (Nodes, PersistentVolumes) are cluster-scoped (unique cluster-wide).
Generated names (e.g., ReplicaSets) append a random suffix (pod-template-hash).
